**LaküenPlay v1.1 – PC** is a performance and stability update to the Linux fork of [Lichii](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii) **build 130** for desktop Linux and SteamOS PCs.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> This is an unofficial fork, not an official Lichii release. Please report problems [here](https://github.com/elkarbeenus/Lichii_improvments_ram/issues), not upstream. Games, keys and firmware are not included: only use content you have legally obtained.

## Downloads

| File | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `LakuenPlay-v1.1-PC-x86_64-pgo.AppImage` | **Recommended.** Self-contained, compiled with profile-guided optimization |
| `LakuenPlay-v1.1-PC-x86_64.AppImage` | The same program without PGO, for comparison |
| `*.tar.gz` | Plain binaries that use your system libraries |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | Checksums |

Make the AppImage executable (`chmod +x LakuenPlay-*.AppImage`) and run it. Data folders and settings are shared with Lichii and v1.0.

## What's new since v1.0

### Performance
- **Texture cache capped at 3.5 GiB on PCs with 16 GB of RAM or less.** What a card's VRAM can't hold, the driver keeps in system RAM, where the GPU reads it far more slowly. Measured on a Ryzen 7 5800X3D / RX 6600 XT (8 GB) with 16 GB of RAM: **~37 → ~57 fps** in a busy village, **~37 → ~42 fps** in a large open area. `EDEN_NX2_TC_LOW_RAM=0` restores the old cap.
- **A frame can start ahead of the GPU threads** (frame-ahead 2), so the game, the GPU threads and the GPU overlap more. Adds one frame of latency. `EDEN_NX2_FRAMES_AHEAD=1` turns it off.
- **More fast draws.** Writes to render-target slots a draw doesn't use no longer force a full draw setup. `EDEN_NX2_FAST_DRAW_RT_SLOTS=0` turns it off.
- **Fewer render-target uploads.** Fresh render targets on stale pages skip the upload ([Lichii #1241](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/1241)).
- **The background memory cleanup backs off.** When it frees little it runs every 5 minutes instead of every minute (from [Fritchii](https://github.com/Frizti/Fritchii) v5.7). `EDEN_NX2_ZERO_TRIM_IDLE=0` restores 60 s.

### Stability
- **No more out-of-memory exits on 16 GB systems** in heavy areas, thanks to the texture cache cap above.
- **Over the memory budget, buffers are still allocated** instead of aborting the emulator ([Lichii #959](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/959)).
- **The process is held until queued memory work has run**, so ending a game can't read freed memory ([Lichii #1236](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/1236)).
- **Exit and Stop are no longer bound to controller hotkeys**, so a stray Home/Guide chord can't open "close Lichii?". The keyboard shortcuts stay. `EDEN_NX2_CONTROLLER_EXIT=1` restores them.

### Diagnostics
- **The log is written out on a crash**, with the fatal signal or Vulkan device loss named, instead of ending mid-line.
- **Every close request is logged with its source**: window system, program or SIGTERM.

- **Textur-Cache max. 3,5 GB** bei 16 GB RAM: in Kakariko ~37 → ~57 fps, auf der Steppe ~37 → ~42 fps. Keine Abstürze mehr wegen vollem Arbeitsspeicher.
